description: This file contains unit tests for the AddressSorterPosix class, which sorts IP addresses based on various network policies and preferences. It includes mock socket classes, test setup, and multiple test cases implementing different address sorting rules.

classes.name: TestUDPClientSocket
classes.description: Mock UDP socket class used for testing address mapping and connection behaviors.

classes.name: TestSocketFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create mock UDP sockets and manage address mappings for tests.

classes.name: AddressSorterPosixTest
classes.description: Test fixture for AddressSorterPosix, setting up environment and helper methods.

classes.name: AddressSorterPosixSyncOrAsyncTest
classes.description: Parameterized test fixture for AddressSorterPosix with different connection modes.

methods.name: ParseIP
methods.description: Parses a string literal into an IPAddress object.

methods.name: OnSortComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of address sorting, verifies success and stores sorted addresses.

methods.name: AddMapping
methods.description: Adds a destination-to-source IP address mapping for testing.

methods.name: SetSocketCreateCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to track socket creation during tests.

methods.name: SetConnectMode
methods.description: Configures the connection mode (sync/async) for test sockets.

methods.name: GetSourceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes source address info for a given IP address.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies that a list of addresses sorts into a specified order after applying rules.
